# Dear ImGui SDL3 backends

Unmodified SDL3 platform and SDL_Renderer3 backends from Dear ImGui commit
`64944b4520b30772de8dbf0b37d0311746477a32`, matching the bundled core's
`third_party/imgui/VERSION.txt`. MIT license in `LICENSE.txt`.

Kept separately because the bundled ImGui directory is not edited. These files
are compiled only by the optional SDL3 example applications.
